question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to be dismantled in relation to dismantling?
data_point: ability of the product to be dismantled
description: Ability of the product to be dismantled refers to the product's capability to be taken apart in a way that allows some parts to be either reused or recycled. This aspect is crucial in dismantling processes as it enables the potential for certain components to have a second life through reuse or recycling, contributing to sustainable practices in product end-of-life management.
